fact: The Global Findex 2025 (fieldwork 2024) puts account ownership among Zambian adults at 72.7% and adults who made or received a digital payment at 71.2%, while FinScope 2025 puts financial inclusion at 80.1%.
title: Digital financial inclusion and inclusive growth in Zambia: Evidence from global Findex 2025, FinScope 2025 and macroeconomic indicators
